friendly_name: Live Control Plane Integration & Pilot Readiness
source_description: joyus-desktop's policy client, runtime routing, and handoff flows were built against contract interfaces but have never connected to a live joyus-ai control plane. Now that joyus-ai is deployed on AWS (spec 010), this feature closes that gap. Scope: replace stub/mock control plane calls with real HTTP calls, harden the connection layer (requirements defined here; PKI/certs owned by joyus-ai-ops), validate internal and external pilot paths, and complete the operational readiness gate.
